name: UA-Retrofit-Hub-2
title: Access Retrofit Hub
summary: DIN-rail 2-door Access hub for reusing third-party Wiegand readers; 12/24V DC powered.

extra.desc_vs_spec: desc says Wiegand and OSDP; input terminals list Wiegand / UniFi Retrofit Reader only

gotchas: DC-powered (12/24V), not PoE - you need a separate DC PSU.
Built for retrofitting third-party Wiegand readers; OSDP support claimed in desc but not in terminal list - verify.
Indoor only; lock power output limited (12V 1A / 24V 0.5A).
Requires UniFi Access on a console.
best_for: migrating legacy access systems while keeping readers
not_for: new single-door installs (UA-Ultra or G2 kit)
